description.value: Beach Fire Brewing is Campbell River's own craft brewery and taproom, producing award-winning beers such as the gold-medal Ember Red Ale and the locally beloved High Tide Pale Ale alongside a kitchen stocked with ingredients from regional farmers. The brewery is a community partner of the River City Cycle Club and even names one of its year-round beers 'WheelBender Stout,' giving it a natural affinity with the cycling crowd. Growlers, howlers, and cans are available to go, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists looking to restock before the next stretch of Vancouver Island road.

The community page notes a partnership with the River City Cycle Club but this is not evidence of physical cyclist amenities.
